Good evening. Welcome to the Riverside. Can I have your name?
Good evening. Leão de Souza. I have a booking for three nights.
Let me see... I am sorry, but your name is not in the system.
But I have the confirmation here, on my phone. Look.
Yes, I can see it. It was our mistake. But the hotel is full tonight.
It is eleven at night and I am very tired. Can I talk to the manager?
Of course. One moment, please.
OK, good news. We have a suite on the tenth floor, so we can give you an upgrade.
Really? That is great. Is it the same price?
Yes, and the manager wants to give you a discount for tonight, because it was our mistake.
Thank you, Sofia. It was a bad start, but it worked.
We are very sorry. Maybe you can write us a good review?

So, I arrived in Chicago on Friday, and I went to my hotel. I had a booking, but it was for the wrong dates. It was for next Friday! The hotel was full, so I needed to find another hotel at ten at night. I called three hotels, but they were full too. Then the receptionist called a friend at a small hotel near the station, and they had a room. It was small and a little old, but it was clean and very cheap. And you know what? The breakfast was the best of my trip. So now I always check my dates two times.

My first day in Mexico City was a little crazy. The flight was on time, but my bag was the last one on the belt. I wanted to take the train to the hotel, but it was very crowded, so I took a taxi. The taxi was slow, because the traffic was terrible, so I arrived late for dinner. The restaurant was full, but the waiter was very kind, and he found a small table for me near the kitchen. I ate tacos and I talked to the cook. I was very tired, but I was happy. A long day, but a good end.
